products.product_description: Fresh Thai chili peppers. Loose fresh Thai chili peppers packaged with inner plastic mesh bag into paper carton cardboard boxes. Imported bulk. Outer carton labeling reads in part: "***PRODUCE OF MEXICO***JAMMIN PEPPERS***THAI CHILI***DISTRIBUTED BY: JT BROKERAGE 651 KOHLER ST. LOS ANGELES, CA 90021***WWW.JAMMINPEPPERS.COM***".
products.code_info: Bulk outer carton labelets with Lot # 162. Sold to retail with no coding or marks.
products.reason_for_recall: The firm recalled the Thai chili peppers because FDA analytical results revealed the presence of Salmonella.
